cancelRecovery(bytes).notice: The current PQ key vetoes a pending recovery. Anyone may submit it.

completeRecovery().notice: Finalise a recovery once the delay has passed. Anyone may call.

initiateRecovery(bytes32).notice: Owner wallet proposes a new PQ key (e.g. the old one was lost).

nonce().notice: Increments on every authorised action; binds every signature to one use.

resolveSlotQuarantine(address,address,ad.notice: Resolve quarantine on a Slot whose merchant is this vault.         Without it, a quarantined Slot paying into a vault would be stuck,         because only the merchant may call Slot.resolveQuarantine.

rotateKey(bytes32,bytes,bytes).notice: Replace the PQ key, authorised by the current key (and owner in two-key mode).

withdraw(address,uint256,uint256,uint256.notice: Send `amount` to `to`, paying `relayerFee` to whoever submits.
